headline: FIREFLY HITS 11.5m AT 13.2% COPPER EQ AT GREEN BAY, PLUS 42m AT 6.1% — PEA On Track For End Of August; Resource Already 80Mt At 2.0%+ CuEq (ASX/TSX: FFM)
snippet: FireFly Metals (ASX: FFM, TSX: FFM) released another batch of high-grade copper-gold assays from its Green Bay VMS Project in Newfoundland on August 3, 2026, led by 11.5 metres at 13.2% CuEq (11.1% Cu, 2.1 g/t Au), alongside 42.0m at 6.1% CuEq and 51.5m at 4.9% CuEq from the upper VMS lenses and Core Zone. Results will feed into an updated mineral resource estimate underpinning a Preliminary Economic Assessment due by end of August 2026 — a near-term binary catalyst for a project whose existing resource stands at 50.4Mt at 2.0% CuEq M&I plus 29.3Mt at 2.5% CuEq inferred, making Green Bay one of the highest-grade undeveloped copper-gold deposits in North America.

headline: DIGGERS & DEALERS OPENS TODAY — 66 ASX Companies Brief Investors At Kalgoorlie; Small Cap Mining Stocks Rally Ahead Of Australia's Premier Mining Forum
snippet: The Diggers & Dealers Mining Forum opened August 3, 2026 in Kalgoorlie, Western Australia, running through August 5 — with approximately 66 listed mining and exploration companies delivering project updates and investment briefings to ~2,600 delegates at Australia's most important annual mining forum. ASX small cap mining stocks rallied in the lead-up as companies dropped operational releases ahead of their D&D presentations, making the August 3-5 window one of the year's highest-density periods for ASX junior mining catalysts; investors tracking Australian gold, copper, and lithium explorers should expect an elevated flow of company news through mid-week.

headline: NGEX DRILLS 546m AT 1.19% CuEq AND 20.5m AT 17.83% CuEq AT LUNAHUASI — Phase 4 Extends Argentina Porphyry 120m South; Remains Open (TSX: NGEX)
snippet: NGEx Minerals (TSX: NGEX) announced Phase 4 final drilling results from its Lunahuasi copper-gold-silver porphyry project in San Juan, Argentina on July 30, 2026 — highlighted by hole DPDH073 returning 546.30 metres at 1.19% CuEq from 446m depth, including a 34m sub-interval at 4.68% CuEq, confirming bulk-tonnage scale at meaningful grade, plus a separate hole hitting 20.50m at 17.83% CuEq, demonstrating a high-grade core within the larger system. The deepest drill hole extended the known mineralized footprint 120 metres further south with the system still open, setting up a Phase 5 program to test continued lateral and depth extensions of what has emerged as one of the most exceptional new copper porphyry discoveries in the Americas this decade.

headline: 1911 GOLD HITS 36.44 g/t Au AT NEW BAKER TARGET, TRUE NORTH MINE, MANITOBA — Three New Near-Mine Zones Defined; Q4 Global Resource Update Planned (TSX-V: AUMB)
snippet: 1911 Gold Corporation (TSX-V: AUMB) reported high-grade gold intercepts from three near-mine targets at its True North Gold Project in Bissett, Manitoba on July 30, 2026 — including 36.44 g/t Au over 1.10m at the newly identified Baker target, 15.89 g/t Au over 2.70m at SAM Southeast, and 5.99 g/t Au over 4.90m at Shore, from 8,656 metres across 30 drill holes. The three new targets sit in close proximity to the existing True North mill infrastructure, and management has scheduled a Q4 2026 global resource update to incorporate Baker, SAM SE, and Shore — a near-mine discovery program with infrastructure already in place that dramatically reduces the capex bar for resource conversion to production.

headline: HECLA Q2 SILVER EXPLORATION: 62.7 oz/ton Ag OVER 10.2 FEET AT KENO HILL BERMINGHAM DEEP — 169.5 oz/ton At Greens Creek; New Midas Veins Found; $55M Full-Year Budget (NYSE: HL)
snippet: Hecla Mining (NYSE: HL), the largest US silver producer, reported Q2 2026 exploration results on July 29 showing the Bermingham Deep high-grade trend at Keno Hill in Yukon extended 165 feet in both directions — with hole 935C returning 62.7 oz/ton silver over 10.2 feet and hole 936C returning 44.6 oz/ton silver over 10.1 feet, extending the trend over 800 feet of strike toward the historic Hector-Calumet Mine. Greens Creek (Alaska) returned 169.5 oz/ton Ag, 0.55 oz/ton Au, 5.8% Zn, and 3.2% Pb over 8.4 feet in the East Zone, while two new veins were discovered at the Midas mine Sinter-Pogo Gap target — all within Hecla's $55 million full-year exploration investment, the largest among primary US silver producers and a direct driver of mine-life extensions at each of its three operations.

headline: PUREPOINT URANIUM HITS 5.6m RADIOACTIVITY PEAKING AT 53,300 CPS AT NOVA DISCOVERY, DORADO — Lab Assays Pending At Athabasca Basin Target With Previous 8.1% U3O8 (TSX-V: PTU / IsoEnergy JV)
snippet: Purepoint Uranium Group (TSX-V: PTU) and joint venture partner IsoEnergy Ltd. reported that summer drill hole NV26-11 at the Dorado Project in Saskatchewan intersected 5.6 metres of continuous radioactivity averaging 11,730 counts per second (cps), peaking at 53,300 cps at the Nova Discovery — results published July 30, 2026 ahead of a mid-program break. Lab assays are pending, but the radiometric response is consistent with the high-grade uranium mineralisation previously confirmed at Nova, where prior drilling returned up to 8.1% U3O8 over 0.4 metres within a 1.62% U3O8 over 2.1-metre intercept; the 5.6-metre continuous radioactivity signature is a direct indicator of a material mineralized interval at depths consistent with the unconformity-related uranium systems that host Athabasca Basin's high-grade deposits.

headline: KOREA AND CHILE SIGN CRITICAL MINERALS MOU — $2.1B Annual Mineral Supply Elevated To Ministerial Level; Lithium And Copper Supply Chain Resilience Framework Established
snippet: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung and Chilean President Jose Antonio Kast signed five MOUs on July 30-31, 2026, including a critical minerals partnership elevating South Korea's Joint Committee on Mineral Resources with Chile — the world's number one country by lithium and copper reserves — to the ministerial level, establishing a new director-general working channel, and creating a long-term framework spanning mineral exploration, processing, technology, and supply chain resilience. Chile supplies $2.1 billion annually in minerals to South Korea, and the agreement institutionalises cooperation at a moment when Korean battery manufacturers are increasingly exposed to supply disruption risk from China's export controls on lithium processing; the MOU represents a state-level hedging mechanism that strengthens the investment case for Chilean lithium and copper development assets.

headline: NdPr HITS NEW 2026 HIGH AT $133/kg AND CHINA'S H2 MINING QUOTA STILL NOT ANNOUNCED — MOFCOM Export Licensing Tightens Supply; Magnet REE Demand Accelerating
snippet: NdPr alloy reached $133.02/kg on the SMM domestic China benchmark as of July 2026 — a new high for 2026 and up from approximately $53/kg at the start of the year, a 151% gain driven by a second consecutive year of supply deficit, accelerating EV and wind turbine magnet demand, and MOFCOM export licensing enforcement that has tightened the separation output envelope beyond what official MIIT mining quotas alone would indicate. Critically, China's MIIT H2 2026 mining quota — typically released in June — had not been published as of late July, leaving the single biggest open supply-side catalyst for August unresolved; if the H2 quota comes in below the market's expectation, NdPr pricing could accelerate further, directly benefiting the economics of Western magnet REE projects in advanced development.

headline: ADAM HAMILTON: GOLD STOCKS AUTUMN RALLY '26 HAS STARTED — Seasonal Data Shows 10.1% Average Gain; Oversold Entry Conditions Suggest 'Much Larger' Rally Than Average (GoldSeek)
snippet: Adam Hamilton of Zeal LLC argues in his latest GoldSeek analysis that gold stocks' 2026 autumn rally is underway, with seasonal data showing GDX-type majors average 10.1% gains from mid-July through late September — and that the current entry, coming off deeply oversold technical conditions after summer doldrums that left gold stocks pounded lower by Iran war re-escalation and Fed rate-hike fears, historically produces autumn rallies materially larger than the seasonal average. Hamilton's data shows August historically delivers 3.2% gains for gold stocks (vs 1.9% for gold itself), with the 2026 setup of compressed valuations and record FCF entering the autumn acceleration phase; for TSX-V junior investors, the implication is that the institutional and retail capital flow driving senior miner re-ratings in August-September tends to cascade into smaller-cap explorers with a 4-6 week lag.

headline: SUN PEAK METALS COMPLETES MAIDEN SAUDI ARABIA DRILLING — 23 Holes, 3,764m At Safra And Halahila Targets; Assays Expected Late August (TSX-V: PEAK)
snippet: Sun Peak Metals (TSX-V: PEAK) announced August 3, 2026 that it has completed maiden drilling programs across two Saudi Arabian projects — 23 holes totalling 3,764 metres at the Safra Main Project and Halahila Main Project targets — making it one of the first TSX-V junior explorers to complete a systematic maiden drill campaign in the Kingdom under Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 mining sector liberalisation. Assay results are expected in late August and will provide the first drill-tested resource indicators for both targets; Saudi Arabia hosts one of the world's most underexplored Precambrian basement sequences, and early-mover TSX-V juniors with ground positions in the Kingdom represent a distinct frontier diversification play relative to the crowded Canadian and Australian exploration landscape.
